candidate_designs.claim_limit: paired net evidence of context-responsive unique-action utilization in the selected finite-DSL challenge only; complete two-arm switching is secondary
paired net evidence of context-responsive unique-action utilization in a separately sealed q6 finite-DSL challenge only; complete two-arm switching is secondary
paired net evidence of context-responsive disjoint-two-choice-set utilization only; never unique-action switching; complete two-arm switching is secondary

primary_estimand.independent_unit: unique development world and its two-context pair
primary_estimand.arm_score: one iff the chosen raw action belongs to that arm's frozen nonconstant-K4 correct set; otherwise zero
primary_estimand.cross_score: rescore each arm's chosen raw action against the other arm's frozen disjoint correct set
primary_estimand.world_signed_score: sum of the two own-context arm scores minus the sum of the two cross-context scores
primary_estimand.primary_test: one-sided exact sign test conditional on non-tie worlds
primary_estimand.null: under no context utilization, the joint two-arm observable outcomes, including received and validity status plus parsed choice when valid, are exchangeable under swapping the arm labels after conditioning on the frozen pair design and schedule; therefore, conditional on a non-tie, favorable probability is at most one half
primary_estimand.null_exchangeability_assumption: the two arm observable outcomes, including received and validity status plus parsed choice when valid, are jointly exchangeable under arm-label swap within each world under the null; independent identically distributed arm outcomes are sufficient but not necessary
primary_estimand.choice_bias_control: under the explicit joint-exchangeability assumption and frozen pair-shared action order, a fixed arm-invariant raw-action or display-position bias is sign-symmetric; equality of expected own and cross scores or hard balance alone does not establish the exact sign-test null
required_execution_controls: pair-shared opaque option IDs and raw-action order
arm-order and display schedules sealed independently of world content, target identities and model outcomes
same prompt wording and response contract apart from the rendered context
pre-live justification and canary of joint arm-exchangeability for received status, validity and parsed choice; if it is not defensible, the sign-test gate is not valid
primary_estimand.invalid_received_response: if either arm has a received but invalid response, classify the entire world as a primary tie and a complete-switch miss; keep it in the fixed denominator
primary_estimand.transport_or_missing_response: the affected complete route attempt is non-evaluable; no retry, replacement world, or partial denominator

route_family.future_multiplicity_method: Holm step-down across the three frozen route hypotheses within one selected tier
route_family.conservative_design_alpha_interpretation: a route reaching this raw threshold survives the first Holm step regardless of the other two route p-values
route_family.joint_route_power_reason: cross-route dependence on the same worlds is unknown and routes are not pooled

power_model.method: exact finite binomial enumeration under the frozen homogeneous independent-world working model with rational arithmetic; no Monte Carlo and no normal approximation
power_model.working_model: independent worlds with one common p_favorable and p_adverse within the selected tier; this is a prospective sensitivity model, not a guarantee under stratum heterogeneity
power_model.interpretation: power is exact only under the frozen homogeneous working alternative; a later benchmark must report stratum-wise outcomes and may require a separately sealed stratified or Poisson-binomial sensitivity analysis

parameterization.p_favorable: unconditional probability that a world has positive own-minus-cross score
parameterization.p_adverse: unconditional probability that a world has negative own-minus-cross score
parameterization.conditional_favorable_probability: p_favorable divided by p_favorable plus p_adverse

frozen_sesoi.name: mechanism_scale_context_utilization
frozen_sesoi.rationale: on a deliberately opportunity-enriched mechanism challenge, a live experiment is worthwhile only if it can detect at least a fifty-percentage-point net world-level direction signal

secondary_endpoints.complete_context_concordant_switch: both arms choose an action in their own correct set; necessarily different because the sets are disjoint
secondary_endpoints.baseline_rule: freeze a target-blind structural policy or multiplicity-adjusted policy family on the later exact cohort; do not reuse the old fair-choice B-star and do not select a new inferential baseline after live outcomes
secondary_endpoints.baseline_hurdle_role: secondary non-inferential shortcut sensitivity unless separately powered and multiplicity-adjusted before live calls

go_no_go.per_design_pass_rule: exact primary power at the frozen SESOI and conservative design alpha is at least target_power
later_benchmark_requirements: separately sealed tier, q, pair matching and cohort
hard balance of correct raw action, path/frame, child behavior and control-bundle diversity
opaque display permutation, context order and route schedule
public manifest and private scoring key exact-byte bindings
route identities and response contract canaries
target-blind baseline family and all inferential labels
source/config drift barriers and complete-attempt failure policy
go_no_go.human_decision_after_degraded_only_pass: either accept the narrower degraded question or create a wholly new larger strict construction protocol; never silently promote degraded evidence to strict

artifact_contract.interpretation_limit: prospective operating-characteristic calculation only; it does not observe utilization, rank models, estimate natural-world opportunity rates, establish causality, or authorize live calls
